event.title: US Indicts Nicolás Maduro and Wife on Torture Charges
event.canonical_title: US Indicts Nicolás Maduro and Wife on Torture Charges
event.summary: US authorities have charged former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, with conspiracy to commit torture. This new indictment adds to existing drug trafficking allegations against Maduro and relates to the alleged torture of US citizens during his presidency. The charges are part of a broader effort to hold Maduro accountable for human rights abuses in Venezuela.

timeline.title: Nicolas Maduro and Wife Plead Not Guilty to Torture Charges
timeline.summary: Nicolas Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, have pleaded not guilty to new charges of torture related to their efforts to maintain power in Venezuela. Maduro has described the allegations as false accusations.
key_facts: Nicolas Maduro and Cilia Flores pleaded not guilty to torture charges.
